g.text: POWER INPUT: J1 (panel jack leads) -> F1 2A slow-blow -> J7 (panel switch loop) -> +24V bus

g.desc: POWER INPUT: J1 (panel jack leads) -> F1 2A slow-blow -> J7 (panel switch loop) -> +24V bus

g.text: MCPCB HEADERS: J2-J5 -> LED boards. Red chain J2>J3>J4>J5, blue J2>J3, deep-red J4>J5 (series joins on this PCB).

g.desc: MCPCB HEADERS: J2-J5 -> LED boards. Red chain J2>J3>J4>J5, blue J2>J3, deep-red J4>J5 (series joins on this PCB).

g.text: ESP32-C3 SuperMini plugs onto J6. GPIO0-3 -> 1k -> CTRL_x; 100k pull-downs keep LEDs off during boot.

g.desc: ESP32-C3 SuperMini plugs onto J6. GPIO0-3 -> 1k -> CTRL_x; 100k pull-downs keep LEDs off during boot.

g.text: LED DRIVER CHANNELS (7x AL8860WT-7, TSOT-25). High-side sense: +24V -> RSET -> SET pin = LED string anode; string cathode -> L -> SW; D freewheels SW -> +24V. I_LED = 0.1V / RSET.

g.desc: LED DRIVER CHANNELS (7x AL8860WT-7, TSOT-25). High-side sense: +24V -> RSET -> SET pin = LED string anode; string cathode -> L -> SW; D freewheels SW -> +24V. I_LED = 0.1V / RSET.

g.text: LOGIC POWER: IRM-02-5 24V->5V, AMS1117 5V->3V3. VERIFY IRM-02-5 PINOUT VS DATASHEET.

g.desc: LOGIC POWER: IRM-02-5 24V->5V, AMS1117 5V->3V3. VERIFY IRM-02-5 PINOUT VS DATASHEET.

g.text: AL8860 RESOLVED 2026-09-08: 'AL8860W6-7 SOT-23-6' DOES NOT EXIST (LCSC C460356 = AP3012 boost, wrong part). Use AL8860WT-7 TSOT-25, LCSC C125330. Pinout per DS39014: 1=SW 2=GND 3=CTRL 4=SET 5=VIN.

g.desc: AL8860 RESOLVED 2026-09-08: 'AL8860W6-7 SOT-23-6' DOES NOT EXIST (LCSC C460356 = AP3012 boost, wrong part). Use AL8860WT-7 TSOT-25, LCSC C125330. Pinout per DS39014: 1=SW 2=GND 3=CTRL 4=SET 5=VIN.
